edges.reason: Constructor uses _tTotal to set _rTotal and the emitted transfer amount.
calculateTaxFee multiplies the amount by the mutable _taxFee state variable.
calculateMarketingFee multiplies the amount by the mutable _marketingFee.
setFees uses _marketingFee4Sellers when the recipient is the pair.
SwapAndSend sends contract ETH to the mutable marketingWallet.
marketingWallet address is the recipient of the external ETH transfer.
transferFrom subtracts from and updates the allowance mapping.
_transfer consults the fee-exclusion mapping to decide takeFee.
_transfer skips swap-and-send when the sender is the uniswap pair.
SwapAndSend calls the router to swap tokens for ETH.
The router address is the target of the external swap call.
_transfer checks inSwapAndSend to avoid nested swap-and-send.
SwapAndSend sets and clears the inSwapAndSend lock.
_transfer applies dynamic fees when feesOnSellersAndBuyers is set.

Constructor assigns the immutable uniswap pair.
Constructor assigns the immutable uniswap router.
balanceOf uses tokenFromReflection for non-excluded accounts.
tokenFromReflection divides by the current rate.
excludeFromReward flags the account as reward excluded.
excludeFromReward writes the snapshot token balance.
includeInReward zeroes the stored tOwned balance.
excludeFromFee sets the account as fee exempt.
includeInFee clears the account fee exemption.
removeAllFee caches the tax fee before zeroing it.
removeAllFee caches the marketing fee before zeroing it.
addToBlackList writes the blacklist mapping in a loop.
_takeMarketing credits reflection tokens to the contract.
calculateTaxFee performs fee arithmetic with SafeMath mul/div.
calculateMarketingFee performs fee arithmetic with SafeMath mul/div.
_transfer reads its own contract token balance via balanceOf.
_transfer selects fees before applying the transfer.
_transfer triggers SwapAndSend when the token threshold is exceeded.
SwapAndSend approves the router before the external swap.
SwapAndSend performs an external ETH transfer to the marketing wallet.
SwapAndSend makes an external call into the uniswap router.
_tokenTransfer removes fees when takeFee is false.
Constructor derives the initial owner from msg.sender.
transfer uses msg.sender as the token source.
approve sets an allowance owned by msg.sender.
transferFrom spends the caller allowance via _msgSender.

onlyOwner on addToBlackList depends on the caller identity.
onlyOwner on setSwapAndSendEnabled depends on the caller identity.
onlyOwner on _setMarketingWallet lets the owner redirect ETH flows.

SwapAndSend passes block.timestamp as the router deadline, a miner-influenceable value.
transfer amount flows into fee and balance arithmetic.

approve spender is written into the allowance mapping.
approve amount becomes the stored allowance.
_transfer from address drives blacklist and owner checks.
_transfer to address drives pair detection and fee selection.
_transfer amount is compared with _maxTxAmount and split into fees.
contractTokenBalance is derived from balanceOf and capped at _maxTxAmount.
contractTokenBalance is the amount swapped by SwapAndSend.
_tokenTransfer amount is forwarded into the value calculations.
tAmount drives all reflection and fee computations.
currentRate multiplies the marketing token amount.
path array defines the swap route token->WETH.
contractETHBalance is measured before the ETH transfer.
contractETHBalance is sent out to the marketing wallet.
tFee is subtracted from tAmount in _getTValues.
tMarketing is subtracted from tAmount in _getTValues.
tTransferAmount is returned as the net transfer value.
